description: Single Source of Truth declarative manifest for gRPC cross-language interoperability testing, HTTP/2 interop testing, Docker image builds, and historical backward-compatibility release matrices.

cloud_to_cloud.description: Cross-language client-to-server interop tests in Docker containers.

cloud_to_prod.description: Client-to-production server interop tests over TLS / custom credentials.

cloud_to_prod_auth.description: Client-to-production authentication and credential interop tests.

http2_client.description: HTTP/2 edge-case client tests against cloud_to_prod and cloud_to_cloud servers.

http2_server.description: HTTP/2 negative and framing edge-case server tests across 8 ports.

matrix.description: Historical gRPC client release backward-compatibility matrix tests.

build_commands: mkdir -p cmake/build && cd cmake/build && cmake -DgRPC_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 ../.. && make interop_client interop_server -j4 && make http2_client -j4

mkdir -p /var/local/grpc_java_logging && printf 'handlers = java.util.logging.ConsoleHandler
java.util.logging.ConsoleHandler.level = ALL
.level = FINE
io.grpc.netty.NettyClientHandler = ALL
io.grpc.netty.NettyServerHandler = ALL
' > /var/local/grpc_java_logging/logconf.txt

client_cmd.arg_template: pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Tests.xcworkspace -scheme InteropTestsLocalSSL -destination name="iPhone 6" HOST_PORT_LOCALSSL=localhost:{port} test

build_commands: rvm --default use ruby-3.1.3 && cd src/ruby && gem install bundler && bundle && bundle exec rake compile
